# PL-7c: Manage Duplicate Player

_Bucket for everything related to duplicate Player detection/handling — deferred to a later phase until the approach is scoped._

### FIELDS

* Possible Duplicate Flag — Checkbox (already exists on Player)

* No automation currently sets this field. Per the Aug 24 sync, remove it from the Player page layout for now (keep the field, just hide it) until this ticket's logic is built.

### IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS

* Not expected to be needed in the normal flow, but bucketed here for when it is. The agency/CMS handles deduplication at player creation, so a duplicate should only arise if a player is created manually and bypasses that check, or an email address changes afterward.
* Bucket all duplicate-handling logic here for a later phase, rather than building it now. Needs More Info until the dedup approach is scoped.

### NOTES

* Provenance: raised in the Aug 24 Kobi/Taryn Weekly Planning sync while reviewing Player System/Integration Fields (BUILD-177). Not part of the original Player Record User Stories doc as a standalone story.
* Related but separate: [BUILD-229 — Player: Source System & Source Reference Fields](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217798706703645/f/), split off in the same conversation.

### SOURCE

* Aug 24 Kobi/Taryn Weekly Planning — [transcript](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qB7cUeJGFs_SZba9NX5R9MWKzOj8yTetmWTWoqY3gw8/edit), verified.
* Dependencies: [BUILD-177 — Player: System / Integration Fields](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217686867099622/f/)
* Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer
* Created 2026-08-24 from the Aug 24 Kobi/Taryn Weekly Planning sync.
